summary: Lewis Hamilton confronts redemption at Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli closes in on the championship, needing only points to clinch the title after Hamilton's costly Singapore miscalculation handed Ferrari the momentum advantage. Carlos Sainz lurks as a dangerous secondary threat, capable of disrupting Antonelli's coronation while simultaneously chasing his own podium consistency against McLaren's pace. A victory for Antonelli would crown Ferrari's unlikely title surge and expose Hamilton's strategy misstep as the pivotal moment that swung the entire season.
